svg.text: PLAN loop 44 x 6 m = 100 m (side 1: ASSY + TEST; side 2: PAINT, PACK, UNLOAD)
Red dots: the 21 carriers (1 at LOAD, 1 per spur work position, the rest queuing on the line).
Black squares: 4 drive sections of 25 m (0.75 kW each). Circles: 4 corner units.
Spurs alternate inside / outside on side 1 (pitch 1.3 m along the line, 2.6 m per side).
Queue capacity = segment length / carrier pitch 2 m (queues wait on the accumulation chain).
